entities.summary: Flamenco rock or Andalusian rock is a rock music fusion genre that emerged from the Spanish region of Andalusia throughout the late 1960s and early 1970s. There were some precedents like a couple of albums by Sabicas, a handful of singles by Smash, Gong, Galaxia, Flamenco or even the American-British band Carmen. However, Triana was recognized as a pioneer of the genre since their music focuses on a homogeneous fusion of the progressive rock and flamenco. Many bands that mixed progressive and symphonic rock with flamenco followed them, such as Imán Califato Independiente, Cai, Guadalquivir, Alameda or Mezquita; that is why the term Andalusian rock may be understood simply as flamenco prog.
